hotels.title: Secluded Oceanfront West Bali National Park Eco-Villas with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Embrace West Bali National Park’s spectacular beauty with a villa stay at this eco-retreat, a top safari stay offering new levels of luxury in the heart of the wilderness. Return from days exploring the park to moments spent by the resort’s ocean-facing infinity pool, authentic Indonesian plates at The Octagon Ocean Club and soul-stirring sunsets best viewed from Wantilan Deck. Renowned for its lush mangroves, savanna, monsoon forests and coral Islands, Menjangan Island is a paradise for nature lovers. Your days will be filled with a wealth of resort-backed excursions and activities, including traditional Balinese mejejaitan weaving and jamu-making, as well as a schedule filled with snorkelling, cycling, kayaking and more.
